title: Lutaa hai gulshan-e-Zehra isi Moharram mein
body:
Lutaa hai gulshan-e-Zehra isi Moharram mein
Chuttaa hai Sheh sey Madina isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mein Sheh pa huvaa saathveen sey paani bandh
Rahaa Furaath pa pehraa isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mein Aun-o-Mohammad ki laash laaye Shah
Shaheed hogaya dulhaa isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mein qatl huvaa Naujawaan Ali Akbar
Bahaa hai khoon-e-tamanna isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain pyaasey ka baazu isi mein tootaa hai
Shaheed hogaya Saqqaa isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Chiddaa kay teer sey hulqoom Sheh kay haathoun par
Tadap kay rehgayaa bachcha isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mahiney mein sar katt gaya namazi ka
Lahad sey niklee hai Zehra isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mahiney mein masnadh jalee payambar ki
Pidar ko royi Sakina isi Moharram mein
Isi mahiney mein qaidi banay Nabi kay Haram
Chinnee hai chaadar-e-Zehra isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Jigar kharaash hai Shoukath Hussain ki rudaad
Yateem hogayi Sughra isi Moharram mein
